description: npm fragment. Every npm repo in this org is an application or a site — none publish to the
registry — so ranges are bumped in package.json rather than only in the lockfile, which keeps
the manifest an honest record of what actually ships.

packageRules.description: Apps, not libraries: move the declared range too.
One PR per repo for every non-major npm change.
Astro core and its integrations are released in lockstep and break apart if split.
Cloudflare toolchain moves together: wrangler, the Workers types, and the Workers adapters.
The Node engines range encodes which runtime the site is built for — a deliberate decision, not a dependency.
The .nvmrc pin follows the engines range; move it by hand when the engines range moves.
Dev-only tooling is chore(deps), never fix(deps), regardless of what config:recommended infers.
